lore.background: The legendary RX-78-2 prototype mobile suit defined the One Year War, piloted by ace Amuro Ray. The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex was specifically developed as a high-response, Newtype-use successor unit intended to match Amuro's rapid reaction speeds, featuring internal 90mm forearm Gatling guns and heavy composite Chobham armor.

Developed under SNRI's Formula Project, the F91 represents a breakthrough in miniaturized high-performance mobile suit design. Operating at peak limits triggers its MEPE (Metal Peel-off Effect) heat dissipation protocol, shedding microscopic outer armor layers that create holographic afterimages to confuse enemy targeting systems.

The iconic flagship mobile suit of Project V that turned the tide of the One Year War. Equipped with Luna Titanium armor, a learning computer, and magnet coating upgrades, the RX-78-2 set the engineering baseline for every Federation Gundam model that followed.

A 3rd-generation Gundam specialized in close-quarters combat equipped with the 'Seven Swords' system. Powered by an original GN Drive, Exia possesses near-unlimited operational range and the ability to initiate TRANS-AM mode, releasing compressed GN particles for high-speed combat maneuvers.
Developed under Anaheim's secret 'Gundam Development Project', the GP01 Zephyranthes was engineered as a high-mobility ground combat prototype featuring an advanced escape-capable Core Block System.

series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team

lore.background: An emergency field-rebuilt version of Shiro Amada's heavily damaged RX-79[G] Ground Type. Constructed using spare parts from GM units and custom steel plate armor, the 'Extra 8' sacrificed sleekness for rugged structural durability and tactical practicality.

series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team

lore.background: The early mass-production ground combat mobile suit deployed prior to the standard RGM-79 GM. Sharing 80% component parity with the RX-79[G] Gundam, it provided essential heavy armor and fire support for Federation frontline operations.

series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team

lore.pilot: Shiro Amada / Karen Joshua / Terry Sanders Jr.
lore.background: Limited-production mobile suit built using surplus high-spec parts from the RX-78 development line. Deployed to terrestrial battlegrounds such as Southeast Asia, it features a heavy back-mounted weapon rack system for field-swappable artillery.

The progenitor of all combat mobile suits in the After Colony timeline. Due to its extreme acceleration capabilities, massive Super Vernier thrusters, and immense physical toll on the pilot, the Tallgeese was mothballed for two decades before Zechs Merquise restored it to combat readiness.

A prototype multi-mode mobile suit created under the G-Project. When equipped with the high-mobility Aile Striker pack, the Strike gains powerful atmospheric flight controls and boosted thruster power for atmospheric and space dogfighting.

A specialized late-war Federation mobile suit deployed behind enemy lines during the European theater operations of the One Year War. Designed for high mobility and decisive surprise attacks against Zeon positions.

The core control mobile suit unit of the massive RX-78GP03 Dendrobium mobile weapon system. Equipped with specialized robotic manipulator arms inside its forearms, it retrieves ordnance directly from the Dendrobium's giant weapons container.

An experimental mobile suit incorporating a full Psycho-Frame chassis. When detecting enemy Newtypes, the NT-D system initiates Destroy Mode, expanding the frame, revealing red glowing psycho-frame armor, and unlocking extraordinary combat capabilities.

An upgraded post-One Year War refinement of the standard RGM-79 GM. Featuring enhanced cooling, thruster balance, and structural reliability, the GM Type C served as the backbone of Federation garrison forces in the early UC 0080s.

A ultra-compact 15-meter mobile suit developed by SNRI to counter the rising weight and cost of giant late-UC mobile suits. Outfitted with high-power output V.S.B.R. cannons capable of piercing I-Fields.

Developed by the elite Titans faction as the successor to the original RX-78. Introduced the revolutionary 'Movable Frame' structural concept, which separated outer armor from internal framework to drastically increase articulation and power transfer.

series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team

lore.background: A highly refined, master-tier modification of the original MS-07B Gouf. Replaced fixed finger guns with detachable arm weaponry and a deadly heat wire magnetic launcher, famously piloted by Norris Packard during the defense of Shiroda.

series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team

lore.pilot: Shiro Amada / Karen Joshua / Terry Sanders Jr.
lore.background: A terrestrial assault mobile suit designed to combat early Zeon ground forces. Equipped with heavy armor plating, internal calf-stored beam sabers, and customizable backpack cargo systems.
Modern engineering re-imagining of the granddaddy mobile suit for the 35th GunPla anniversary, offering peak articulation, sleek proportions, and clean color separation.
Earth combat variant of the Gundam Development Project. Code-named 'Zephyranthes' after the rain lily, it features advanced terrestrial mobility and high-response control thrusters.

The Earth Federation's foundational mass-production mobile suit built using streamlined data from the RX-78-2 Gundam. Its low unit cost and simplified manufacturing enabled the Federation to overwhelm Zeon through superior deployment numbers.

The ultimate configuration of the V2 Gundam, equipping both heavy gold armor assault plating and long-range fire support buster gear simultaneously. Powered by Minovsky Drive engines generating its devastating 'Wings of Light'.
Space-rebuilt upgrade of the GP01 Zephyranthes following severe combat damage. Outfitted with shoulder thrusters and high-output Universal Boost Pods on its back for unrivaled zero-G mobility.

A heavily armord, high-firepower mobile suit deployed into the debris-strewn Thunderbolt Sector. Uses shoulder-mounted articulating sub-arms to wield four shields simultaneously while maintaining massive offensive output.

Developed by SNRI for high-gravity Jupiter sphere operations under the guise of the Crossbone Vanguard pirates. Features X-shaped thrusters, pirate-style close-quarters melee armament, and a fabric ABC Cloak that dissipates beam strikes.

A tactical covert-ops variant of the standard Jegan customized for the Federation's ECOAS special forces unit. Features reinforced sensor visors, stealth coating, and specialized close-quarters tactical mounts.

A mystery mobile suit constructed using Rayhunton technology from Towasanga. Utilizing high-efficiency Photon Batteries, it can change outer body colors dynamically based on whichever specialized backpack module is attached.

One of 72 Gundam Frame units constructed during the historic Calamity War to eliminate Mobile Armor threats. Powered by dual Ahab Reactors and linked to Mikazuki Augus via the physical Alaya-Vijnana neuro-interface system.

ZAFT's high-performance master suit designed for ace pilot Shinn Asuka. Combines long-range, artillery, and close-quarters capabilities onto one frame powered by a nuclear Hyper-Duutrion drive system.
Piloted by Kira Yamato, this mobile suit features gold-plated internal frame jointing and eight remotely guided Super DRAGOON pods for overwhelming multi-directional combat targeting.
One of the prototype Astray suits secretly produced at Heliopolis. Salvaged and customized by elite mercenary Gai Murakumo, who adapted its modular frame for high-tactical mercenary missions.

Built from spare parts of the original GAT-X105 Strike for Cagalli Yula Athha. Equipped with the Integrated Weapons Striker Pack (I.W.S.P.), combining heavy flight engines, anti-ship swords, and high-output artillery into one package.

One of five Gundams dispatched to Earth during Operation Meteor. Designed strictly for artillery suppression, Heavyarms carries immense internal missile pods, chest Gatling guns, and a shield-mounted beam Gatling cannon.

lore.pilot: Heero Yuy / Duo Maxwell / Zechs Merquise
lore.background: The original Gundam framework designed by all five Operation Meteor engineers. Houses the terrifying ZERO System, a tactical interface that feeds combat prediction calculations directly into the pilot's mind, along with the colony-destroying Twin Buster Rifle.
The ultimate mobile suit synthesized by the AGE System. Custom-engineered for high-level X-Rounders, it controls detachable wireless energy C-Funnels for offensive blading and defensive forcefields.
Constructed by Vagan using captured data from EXA-DB and EX-DB systems. Combines Gundam structural design with organic Vagan technology to control wireless energy Legilis Bits.

Peil Technologies' mass-production mobile suit line. Designed with lightweight frames, vectoring thrusters, and clean internal wiring for flight maneuvers inside school duels and industrial defense work.
A heavily customized concept mobile suit built off Burion's Demi series. Features the separable 'Baori' back-pack module that can act as an independent flight unit or secondary cannon platform.
The standard training mobile suit used across Asticassia School of Technology. Highly modular and modularly repairable, serving as the canvas for student engineering and piloting tests.
Customized by the Earth House mechanics for Chuchu. Outfitted with a long-range sniper rifle that hooks directly into the suit's rear reactor to punch well above standard Demi Trainer specs.
A modified GUND-ARM variant operated by the Earth terrorist group 'Dawn of Fold'. Featuring long limbs, short torso proportions, and a rear-mounted Phased Array Cannon for area destruction.

An extensive repair and overhaul of the original XVX-016 Gundam Aerial following severe damage. Features thruster wings, enhanced GUND Format output, and a modular Beam Rifle that combines with all GUND-Bit staves for devastating beam blasts.

Developed jointly by Jeturk Heavy Machinery and Shin Sei using hidden GUND-ARM technology. Wields the versatile 'Guardian' defensive greatsword, which splits into multiple GUND-Bit energy shields and thrust weapons.

A prototype GUND-ARM suit confiscated during the Vanadis Incident. Operating without Permet filters, it places extreme physical strain on the pilot, but possesses power capabilities capable of reaching high Permet Scores.
An experimental mobile suit prototype featuring unique mechanical geometry, advanced heat dissipation fins, and specialized high-frequency particle armament.

series: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon

lore.background: The iconic Armored Core frame piloted by the legendary mercenary Raven. Built for versatility across Rubicon 3, featuring the devastating ASHMEAD Pile Bunker weapon.

series: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon

lore.background: A bizarre, industrial salvage Armored Core assembled by RaD and stolen by the unhinged mercenary Honest Brute. Utilizes dual heavy flamethrowers and a massive mechanical chainsaw.

series: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon

lore.background: The signature heavy military Armored Core of Redguns Commander G1 Michigan. Built around Balam's sturdy Melander frame for maximum battlefield resilience.
A high-mobility, ground and naval patrol variant EXM unit featuring hardpoints for modular armor swaps and custom weapons integration.
An agile, lightweight third-faction frame deployed by the Maxion Army, specialized in high-speed covert infiltration and dual-blade assassin tactics.

lore.pilot: Hikaru Ichijyo / Roy Focker / Max Jenius
lore.background: The variable fighter developed by Earth UN Spacy using reverse-engineered alien Overtechnology. Transforms smoothly across Fighter, Gerwalk, and Battroid configurations.
The humanoid combat form of the VF-1 Valkyrie, designed specifically for hand-to-hand and urban engagement against giant Zentradi soldiers.
The hybrid jet-with-legs configuration (Ground Effect Resemblance Walk) engineered for low-altitude hover, VTOL deployment, and surface strafing runs.

lore.pilot: Isamu Alva Dyson / UN Spacy Pilots
lore.background: The standard main variable fighter of the UN Spacy forces throughout the 2040s, balancing robust mechanical reliability with anti-projectile shielding.
Shinsei Industry's forward-swept wing prototype entry in the Super Nova competition on Planet Eden. Engineered for forward maneuvering capabilities and high-G combat maneuvers.

The versatile strike fighter of the Rebel Alliance. Armed with four wing-tip laser cannons and strike proton torpedoes, its articulating S-foils open into attack position to expand firing arcs and heat radiation.
The durable workhorse fighter-bomber of the Alliance. Features heavy forward ion cannons, proton torpedo bays, and stripped-down exterior armor plating for fast field maintenance.
